question.problem:
Find the value of $x$ in the figure below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14191822/assets/6eb087290fa6ea66325d35fa626ef385bb4d4e477e6e1c40057b9f9d7e43d9d4.png)
question.worked_solution:
Since the exterior angles of a triangle sum to $360^{\circ}$, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{145}^{∘}+x+(2x-{25}^{∘}) & ={360}^{∘} \\ {120}^{∘}+3x & ={360}^{∘} \\ 3x & ={240}^{∘} \\ x & ={80}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$
